title: Double Workbench Tree Horizontal Indent Spacing
description: Increase the horizontal indentation between tree levels in the Workbench panel to 2x the default, scoped only to the Workbench panel. All other trees remain unchanged. Implement via indentMultiplier prop on Tree component threaded through TreeContext.
summary: Added indentMultiplier prop to Tree component (TreeRootProps) and threaded it through TreeContext. All tree rendering components (IndentationLines, TreeHierarchyGutter, TreeAlignedRow, TreeSection, SortableTreeItem, TreeItem, FileTreeItem, ControlTreeFolderRow, Label) now read indentMultiplier from context and pass it to the indent calculation functions. PanelTabContent in sketchpad/index.tsx now accepts an optional panelKey prop and passes indentMultiplier={2} to Tree when panelKey === "workbench". All other trees remain at indentMultiplier=1. All 20 existing tests pass.
